digest.component_or_area: fsck command infrastructure and store layer
propositions: Three filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are currently defined in fsck_repair.py but are unrelated to repair logic and are imported by seven production modules, creating an inverted dependency
Move the three primitives from src/rebar/_commands/fsck_repair.py to src/rebar/_store/gitutil.py to eliminate the inverted dependency and establish correct architectural layering

Preserve backward compatibility by maintaining module-level re-exports of all three names in fsck_repair.py so tests using monkeypatch.setattr on fsck_repair module attributes continue to work without modification
Preserve backward compatibility by maintaining re-exports from fsck.py so existing attribute access through fsck._ticket_dirs and fsck._resolve_tracker_git_dir continues to resolve
The move must maintain gitutil.py as a stdlib-only leaf module with no module-level rebar imports, preserving the acyclic dependency graph
All consumers must be repointed to import from gitutil directly, with function-local imports kept deferred to avoid circular dependencies
